description: Header file defining the InputEventsGenerator class for handling Android input events and translating them into Starboard application events, including methods for processing pointer, joystick, and key events, as well as managing device mappings and hat values.

classes.name: InputEventsGenerator
classes.description: Class responsible for converting Android input events into Starboard application events, managing device states, and handling input processing logic.

methods.name: CreateInputEventsFromGameActivityEvent
methods.description: Converts a GameActivity input event (motion or key) into Starboard application events.

methods.name: CreateInputEventsFromSbKey
methods.description: Creates input events from an SbKey, used for accessibility injection.

methods.name: ProcessJoyStickEvent
methods.description: Processes joystick movement events, updating device state.

methods.name: UpdateDeviceFlatMapIfNecessary
methods.description: Updates the mapping of device IDs to joystick flat positions.

methods.name: ProcessFallbackDPadEvent
methods.description: Handles DPad events, synthesizing key events if necessary.

methods.name: UpdateHatValuesAndPossiblySynthesizeKeyEvents
methods.description: Updates hat (DPad) values and generates key events accordingly.
